subtitle: Read comics panel by panel
description:
Comic Viewer is a native Mac reader for your own comic files.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• Panel by panel on the Mac. Most Mac comic readers show whole pages; Comic Viewer reads a page the way you do, one panel at a time, which makes comics comfortable on a laptop screen.
• Works on the comics you already own. Panels are found on your Mac from the page artwork: gutters, drawn borders, and framed panels set over full-page art. No store, no special format, nothing uploaded.
• You can fix what it gets wrong. Draw, resize, reorder or delete panels on any page. Your corrections can be saved inside the CBZ, so they travel with the comic to another Mac.
• Free, with no subscription, no account and no ads. The source code is public.

PANEL BY PANEL
Comic Viewer finds the panels on each page and steps through them in reading order, zoomed to fill the window, with the rest of the page dimmed. Pages that are one big picture are shown whole.

YOUR LIBRARY
Add the folders where your comics live. Comic Viewer shows covers, groups issues into series, remembers where you stopped in each comic, and lets you search. Your files are never moved, and never changed unless you ask for panel edits to be saved inside them.

A COMFORTABLE READER
• Single page or double page, with facing pages paired correctly
• Fit page, fit width, fit height, or pinch to zoom
• Left-to-right or right-to-left (manga), remembered per comic
• Thumbnails and a page scrubber
• Keyboard, click and trackpad swipe navigation

FORMATS
CBZ, CBR, PDF and folders of images. ComicInfo.xml metadata and ACBF panel frames are read when present.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking, no network access. Open source.
promotionalText: Read your own comics one panel at a time on the Mac. Fix any page by hand, and keep the whole collection in one library. Free, no account.
reviewNotes: No account or setup required. Launch the app, choose File > Open and pick any CBZ, CBR or PDF comic (or add a folder of them to the library). The app reads only files and folders the user selects.
